theorems.name: Submission.frt_weight_eq_multiplicity_hausdorff
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (M : Set (Euclidean N)) (θ : Euclidean N → ℝ), M ⊆ U → V.weight Mᶜ = 0 → (∀ x ∈ M, 0 < θ x ∧ HasDensity n V.weight x (ENNReal.ofReal (θ x))) → (∀ L : ℝ, 0 < L → L ≤ 1 → ∃ C : Set (Grassmannian N n × Set (Euclidean N)), C.Countable ∧ (∀ c ∈ C, IsClosed c.2 ∧ ∀ y ∈ c.2, ∀ z ∈ c.2, ‖(y - z) - Grassmannian.project c.1 (y - z)‖ ≤ L * ‖Grassmannian.project c.1 (y - z)‖) ∧ M ⊆ ⋃ c ∈ C, c.2) → (∀ K : Set (Euclidean N), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ K) μHE[n]) ∧ ∀ B : Set (Euclidean N), NullMeasurableSet B V.weight → V.weight B = ∫⁻ x in B ∩ M, ENNReal.ofReal (θ x) ∂μHE[n]
